name: Level-Set Graph Traversal for IV Decomposition
aliases: Level-Set Graph Traversal for IV Decomposition Order
definition: A method to determine the inclusion relationships and decomposition order of Isosurface Volumes (IVs) by traversing a level-set graph from the exterior surface inward.
summary: Level-Set Graph Traversal for IV Decomposition determines the inclusion relationships and decomposition order of Isosurface Volumes by explicitly constructing a topological graph to manage nested feature subvolumes.
